items.title: ToolSmith: An Automatic Tool-Generation Framework for Multimodal Search Agents
items.summary: Recent multimodal search agents use reasoning, vision, and live web search across many turns to answer questions beyond parametric knowledge by orchestrating a small library of hand-crafted search and visual tools. However, the library is laborious to create and maintain, and frozen when new query types, evidence formats, and failure modes are encountered in the wild. Human practitioners, by contrast, cope with insufficient tools by fashioning new ones from familiar parts and reusing them across tasks. items.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) improves large language model search agents by up to 32 exact-match (EM) points over their pre-RL initializations, yet overall accuracy gains do not identify which underlying functional capabilities improve or interact during training. We introduce CO-GRAFT, a reward-agnostic interventional attribution framework in which an RL-trained agent and its pre-RL initialization jointly generate a single trajectory under closed-loop execution with live retrieval. items.summary: Audience response to female-led YouTube channels in Bangladesh has not been measured at scale, and the comments these channels attract are hard to score because they arrive in three different writing systems. This study examines twelve such channels, two per category across six categories, from January 2021 to August 2026, covering 4,717 videos and a census of 558,827 top-level comments. No single writing system dominates the comment set: English accounts for 33.5%, Bangla script for 32.0%, and Banglish (Bengali typed in Latin script and freely mixed with English) for 24.2%. items.title: Handoff at Frontier AI Companies
items.summary: The term "Handoff" captures frontier AI companies' ongoing delegation of all AI Research & Development (AI R&D) functions, including high-level decisions such as safety assessments and deployment decisions, to internally deployed AI agents. Handoff is progressing rapidly and will be complete once no human remains in the loop. This report aims to alert policymakers to the national security threats and Loss of Control risks that Handoff can create, and to advise them on how to monitor and respond to those risks.

items.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become an important component in large language models (LLMs).
